subject: refund inquiry
title: Refund Inquiry
response:
Thanks for reaching out. Refunds are handled on your Billing page. Go to Settings → Billing → Refunds to submit your request. If you don’t see the option, reply with your order number and we’ll help.
— The Support Team

subject: shipping delay
title: Shipping Delay
response:
Thanks for checking in. Live tracking is available on your Orders page. Go to Orders → Select the order → Tracking. If your order is 48 hours past ETA, reply with the order number and we’ll escalate.
— The Support Team

subject: account access
title: Account Access
response:
If you’re locked out, use the “Forgot password” link on the sign-in page. For SSO users, contact your workspace admin. If you still can’t get in, reply with the email address on the account and we’ll verify and assist.
— The Support Team
